User Story

As a system user

I want to be able to generate invoices in the system for goods order

So that I will have possibility to get all the necessary information from one interface

Design: https://xd.adobe.com/view/57a7a0a7-2315-4544-a91b-1cb0fbe99df8-02f4/screen/501d2b71-6165-425d-9481-c0edcbeb34c3/

Acceptance criteria:

  1. From goods order page can be started invoice generation process and not needed to create separate billing run object for order’s invoices.

  2. First step is to create Pro forma invoice and then to create standard invoice.

  3. For one goods order always only one pro forma invoice /invoice is created and not possible to create another one (if user cancels already generated invoice only after that can be created new one)

  4. User should have permission to click on button 'Create Pro forma' invoice to start the process:

    1. 3rd tab appears with generated draft pro forma invoice

    2. User can manually continue process and generate PDF document or manually can delete generated draft document

    3. 4th tab appears if PDF document is generated

    4. After creating real pro forma invoice 3rd and 4th tab disappears and generated real Pro forma invoice is displayed in 3rd tab

    5. When real pro forma invoice is generated button Create invoice appears in 1st, 2nd, 3rd tab in preview mode. If user clicks on it should start real invoice generation based on Pro forma invoice data (even if in goods order something is changed will not be considered)

    6. In 4th tab will be displayed Draft real invoice and user can manually continue process and generate PDF document or manually can delete generated draft document

    7. 5th tab appears if PDF document is generated

    8. After creating real invoice 3rd, 4th and 5th tab disappears and generated real invoice is displayed in 3rd tab

  5. User can delete generated document in any step and after that goods order status should be changed again as confirmed

  6. When pro forma invoice is generated status should be changed as Awaiting payment

  7. While generation invoices or pro forma invoices if any error happens should display in 1st tab generated errors

  8. Generate pro forma invoice

    1. Button is active when user has permission to and status of goods order is Confirmed

    2. When any not cancelled invoice or pro forma invoice is linked to goods order button should be hidden

    3. Button is enabled in preview mode . in edit mode always hidden

  9. Generate invoice

    1. Button is active when user has permission to and real pro forma invoice is already generated and invoice is not generated yet

    2. When not cancelled invoice is linked to goods order button should be hidden

    3. Button is enabled in preview mode . in edit mode always hidden

  10. Permissions for editing goods order

    1. Edit Requested goods orders only

    2. Confirmed goods orders can be edited with additional permission – edit confirmed goods orders

    3. All locked goods orders (orders with created invoices or pro-forma invoices) can be edited with additional permission – edit locked goods orders

      1. All fields are editable

    4. In all goods orders status can be edited with additional permission – edit goods orders statuses (it gives permission to edit only status field)

    5. In all goods orders status button Create Pro-forma invoice can be used with additional permission – create goods order pro-forma invoice (it gives additional permission only to click Create Pro-forma invoice button)

    6. In all goods orders status button Create Invoice can be used with additional permission – create goods order invoice (it gives additional permission only to click Create Invoice button)

  11. Statuses for goods order

    1. Requested can be change as Confirmed (manually), Refused (manually)

    2. Confirmed - can be changed as Awaiting payment (Automatically), Refused (manually)

    3. Awaiting payment - can be changed as paid (Automatically), Refused (manually)

    4. Paid - can be changed as in execution (manually), Refused (manually)

    5. In execution - can be changed as completed (manually), Refused (manually)

    6. Completed - can’t be changed

    7. Refused - can’t be changed

  12. Draft Invoice's tab:

    1. Draft invoices tab is available only after user clicks on ‘Issue Pro forma invoice' button or 'Issue an invoice’

    2. 'Draft Invoices' will be generated according to goods order

      1. Always only one invoice is generated for goods order

        1. Will be displayed pro forma invoice if clicked on ‘Issue Pro forma invoice'

        2. Will be displayed invoice if clicked on 'Issue an invoice’ button

    3. Tab contains fields:

      1. Number

        1. Number of draft invoices should have prefix

      2. Document type

        1. Invoice

        2. Pro forma invoice

      3. Invoice type

        1. Standard

      4. Date of invoice

        1. Date in which the invoice was created

      5. Customer

      6. Accounting period

      7. Basis for issuing

        1. For invoices created from Goods order billing, Basis for issuing is set to «Продажба на стоки/услуги».

      8. Total amount (in default currency)

      9. Action

        1. Edit

          1. Clicking on an edit icon will open draft invoice’s detail page in new browser window

        2. Delete

          1. Clicking on delete button will remove all draft invoices and will enable Pro forma invoice button

    4. Search field

      1. It is possible to search draft invoices with its number

    5. Pagination

      1. To be able to navigate through next/previous page

      2. To be able to navigate to first/last page

      3. To be able to use arrow back/forward for navigation

      4. To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page

    6. Start Generate' button should generate PDF documents and after process is completed display them in the in the next tab

  13. 'PDF Documents' tab

    1. PDF Documents tab is available only after user clicks on 'Start Generate' button

    2. 'PDF documents' will be generated according to goods order

      1. Always only one invoice is generated for goods order

        1. Will be displayed pro forma invoice if clicked on ‘Issue Pro forma invoice'

        2. Will be displayed invoice if clicked on 'Issue an invoice’ button

    3. Listing

      1. To be able to display a list of generated PDF Documents

      2. Newly generated documents will be listed as last record in the list

      3. In the listing invoices are displayed with following columns:

        1. Number

          1. Number of draft invoices should have prefix and its structure can be: FP-D000000001

        2. Document type

          1. Invoice

        3. Invoice type

          1. Standard

        4. Date of invoice

          1. Date in which the invoice was created

        5. Customer

        6. Accounting period

        7. Basis for issuing

        8. Total amount (in default currency)

        9. Action

          1. Edit

            1. Clicking on an edit icon will open draft invoice’s detail page in new browser window

          2. Delete

            1. Clicking on delete button will remove all draft invoices and will enable Pro forma invoice button

      4. Search field

        1. It is possible to search draft invoices with its number

      5. Pagination

        1. To be able to navigate through next/previous page

        2. To be able to navigate to first/last page

        3. To be able to use arrow back/forward for navigation

        4. To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page

      6. When user clicks on 'Start Accounting' button system should generate real invoices and after process is completed display them in the in the Invoice's listing page and also in goods order 3rd tab

Customer Feedbacks: https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-3016
